title: NYC PolicyScope Newsletter Content
description: Strict schema for all AI-generated newsletter content. Every field is required.

subject_line.description: Email subject line. Clear and specific. No clickbait.

preview_text.description: Preview text shown in inbox after subject. Summarizes 2-3 stories.

nyc_updates.description: Short borough-level news blocks. At least one required.

borough.description: NYC borough or 'Citywide' for cross-borough stories.

body.description: 1-3 sentences. Factual, local, useful. No hype.

main_insight.description: 1-2 paragraph editorial insight connecting themes across this week's updates.

feature_title.description: Title of the featured deep-dive article.

feature_body.description: 2-4 paragraphs. Substantive but readable. Local policy focus.

quick_tips.description: Short actionable items: links, deadlines, resources.

cta_text.description: Soft call to action. Community-oriented. No hard sales.
